name: B10-0119/2025 (S&D) – Recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Turkey to act. It condemns Turkey for removing 10 elected mayors from office and replacing them with government-appointed trustees. It asks Turkey to give the mayors their jobs back unless a fair trial has convicted them, to let voters' choices stand, and to end the trustee system. It also asks the European Union's foreign policy chief to consider sanctions on officials who serve as trustees.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks Turkey to reinstate mayors and end trustees.
- **Who it affects:** Dismissed mayors in 10 areas, their voters, and Turkish officials who could face European Union sanctions.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union bodies and Turkey. Turkey is not obliged to comply.
